description.value: A colony of some forty thousand bodies holding about two and a half hectares of shelf near the cleared edge, and the first that answered a drummed enquiry instead of falling silent when one arrived. What acts is the colony: it holds obligations, keeps a running account of them and replaces its bodies without noticing, which is why the discipline records it as one person rather than as a population. It is not a settlement, a swarm or a household, and it has said so at length, twice.
